Omardev_QuickSave 1.0.0
​
Introduction
Hello!, I have recently published my first  plugin for Rpg Maker MZ, I have made is one that allows you to save the game quickly by pressing a button, it also has a sound when saving the game, it shows a customizable text and you can choose which slot and that, all my plugins will be completely free and you can do almost whatever you want with them I don't really care, it would be nice if you leave the name of the author.
Features
Does a quick save when you press a button
A text when you save the game
a sound when the game is saved
you can change the slot of the quick save and the key

How to Use
Install the plugin
Put it into the plugins folder of your project
active it and read the description
Plugin Command
In the plugin Command you can enable or disable the quick save
Download
go to my itchio page or download it here
https://omardev29.itch.io/quick-save-plugin
Terms and Credits
Free to use in any case. Credits no need in the game. (but I will be happy if you put my name in your game!)
You can redistribute the plugin and do practically whatever you want just dont delete the copyright claim and the MIT license clause written inside the plugin
